listening.title: Ground rules for the new remote sync

lines.speaker: Minh (Scrum Master)
lines.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we start, I want to agree on a few rules for our remote meetings.

lines.speaker: Linh (Frontend Developer)
lines.text: Sure. Can we start with cameras? Some people are a bit camera shy.

lines.speaker: Minh (Scrum Master)
lines.text: I understand. Cameras are optional for daily sync, but please turn them on for demos with the client.

lines.speaker: Thao (Backend Developer)
lines.text: That sounds fair. My bandwidth at home is not great, so sometimes my video freezes.

lines.speaker: Minh (Scrum Master)
lines.text: No problem, Thao. If your connection is not stable, just switch off video and keep your audio on.

lines.speaker: Linh (Frontend Developer)
lines.text: What about recording? Last week the client asked why we recorded the call.

lines.speaker: Minh (Scrum Master)
lines.text: Good point. From now on, the host will ask for recording consent at the start of every client meeting.

lines.speaker: Thao (Backend Developer)
lines.text: And if someone needs to drop off early, should they say it in the chat?

lines.speaker: Minh (Scrum Master)
lines.text: Yes, a short message in the chat is enough. You do not need to interrupt the speaker.

lines.speaker: Linh (Frontend Developer)
lines.text: Great. I will write these rules on our team wiki page today.
